name: 321Movies UK
description: 321Movies UK — movies and TV from 321movies.co.uk. Shows verified streams first; offers clearly labelled unverified player links when a CDN blocks probing.

name: CineFreak
description: CineFreak (cinefreak.net) - Bollywood, Hollywood, Hindi dubbed movies, web series & K-Drama. Multi-quality direct streams with honest language labels (dual-audio files marked, switch audio in player). v5: the site domain now follows the domain selected in the plugin's settings (manifest.baseUrl).

name: CineHD
description: CineHD (cinehd.vc) - Movies & series with 8+ servers per title (MovieBox Hindi family, Rock HLS/MP4, VidAPI and more, up to 1080p). TMDB catalog, AES-decrypted Rock servers. v7: the site domain now follows the domain selected in the plugin's settings (manifest.baseUrl); v6: all provider families fetched in parallel (2-3x faster play).

name: CineJoy
description: CineJoy (cinejoy.pk) - Trending Movies & Series with 4 official servers (Nebula, Solara, Lisbon 4K, Athens) + 10+ backup sources. TMDB catalog using CineJoy's own key, WASM-GC stream API documented, fallback to VidLove/VidRock/NxSha for instant HLS/MP4. Verified live.

name: FMoviess
description: FMoviess - Watch HD Movies & TV Shows. Multi-server streams (MoviesAPI + VixSrc), multi-quality HLS with subtitles, Latest Updated section

name: HiCine
description: HiCine - Bollywood & Hollywood movies, series and anime (Hindi dual-audio). Movies, WEB series, K-dramas and anime from hicine.sbs

name: Hindi Dubbed
description: Hollywood Hindi dubbed, South Indian Hindi dubbed, Bollywood and Hindi cartoon/anime - all from 20 official YouTube channels (Goldmines network, Aditya, Bhavani, Volga, DRJ, Shemaroo, Ultra, Pen, Rajshri, B4U, Pokemon Hindi, Discovery Kids). Full movies appear as single items; web series are grouped with auto-updating episodes. Fully on-device: 720p/1080p fMP4 HLS + merged HLS built in pure JS, with 360p MP4 fallback. v2: reports an error instead of showing a blank dashboard when YouTube returns nothing.

name: KDramaMaza
description: KDramaMaza (kdramasmaza.net) - Korean, Chinese, Turkish & Japanese dramas in Hindi/Urdu dubbed. Full episode lists, fast parallel resolution with HubCloud + GDFlix Instant direct-file servers (up to 1080p WEB-DL dual-audio). v4: the site domain now follows the domain selected in the plugin's settings (manifest.baseUrl).

name: KatMovieHD
description: KatMovieHD v9 - Fix Idiots 2026 + season merge: Idiots had 1xPlayer+GoFile not KMHD, now parsed. MobLand S1/S2 merged into 12 eps with Season tabs. All titles now have streams via StreamTape/HubCloud/StreamWish+GDFlix fallback+1xPlayer/GoFile for CAMRip. Geo bypass.

name: NetMirror
description: NetMirror (netmirror.center) - Netflix-style catalog: Bollywood, Hollywood, Anime & Reality TV, heavy on Hindi content. Signed direct-file servers per title/episode (R2 + quality-labeled MP4s, up to 1080p). v6: fixed the install-time crash (a header constant called the geo helper before its constants existed) and the site domain now follows the selected mirror. v5: rate-limit friendly (top-3 links per server).

name: RiveStream
description: RiveStream (rivestream.ru) - "Your Personal Streaming Oasis". TMDB-powered catalog of movies & TV, streamed from rivestream's own Rive server backends (Citadel, Prvibd, River, Kutti, Gbru, HindiSk). Default audio: Hindi - Hindi-dubbed tracks are ranked first in the server list, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali. Verified live.

name: SSR Movies
description: SSR Movies - Hindi dubbed & dual audio movies, Bollywood, Hollywood, web series, WWE shows in 480p-4K. HubCloud + GDFlix download mirrors resolved to direct files

name: SubDubAnime
description: SubDubAnime (subdubanime.site) - Hindi & English dubbed/subbed anime: series, seasons and movies via the Blakite API. Direct HLS per episode (up to 1080p where available). Verified live. v3: hardened the TMDB metadata mapping - description/genre/score values are normalised, so one malformed upstream field can no longer fail the whole dashboard.

name: Vidbox
description: Vidbox (vidbox.vc) - TMDB-powered catalog of movies & TV using vidbox's own TMDB id space. Streams resolve through the Nxsha multi-language server. Hindi audio is ranked first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali; every HLS/DASH manifest is verified before it is offered. v2: removed a dead duplicate stream function and fixed episode items (name/airDate) plus genre tags so they render in the app.
